topic: Filing the wrong bankruptcy chapter vs matching the chapter to your goal (Trent vs Bianca)

scenes.narration: The wrong bankruptcy chapter can erase all your debts and still cost you your house. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera in a courtroom between two giant doors labeled CHAPTER 7 and CHAPTER 13, comic burst banner reads CHOOSE WISELY, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Trent and Bianca both file bankruptcy while behind on their mortgages.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man trent and woman bianca each holding bankruptcy paperwork, small houses behind them stamped BEHIND ON PAYMENTS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Chapter seven wipes unsecured debt fast but never cures mortgage arrears.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an open law book titled CHAPTER 7, credit card bills dissolving above it while a house bill labeled ARREARS stays solid, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Chapter thirteen builds a three to five year catch up plan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an open law book titled CHAPTER 13 beside a staircase of five yearly payment steps leading to a house, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Trent picks chapter seven because it is cheaper and much faster.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man trent confidently signing a form labeled CHAPTER 7, a stopwatch and a small price tag beside him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: His credit cards vanish, but the missed mortgage payments remain owed.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man trent watching credit card bills turn to dust while a stack labeled MISSED MORTGAGE PAYMENTS sits untouched, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Bianca meets a bankruptcy attorney and explains she wants her home.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman bianca across a desk from a friendly attorney, a photo of her house on the desk labeled MY GOAL, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He files chapter thirteen, folding her arrears into a five year plan.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, an attorney filing a document stamped CHAPTER 13 PLAN, woman bianca beside a calendar spanning five years, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Trent's foreclosure restarts just weeks after his discharge letter arrives in the mail.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man trent holding a letter stamped DISCHARGED while a notice stamped FORECLOSURE RESUMES is nailed to his door, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He loses the house he filed bankruptcy hoping to save.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, sad man trent carrying boxes away from a house with a sign staked in the lawn labeled SOLD AT AUCTION, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Bianca finishes her plan, current on her mortgage, still home.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman bianca smiling on her porch holding a paper stamped PLAN COMPLETE MORTGAGE CURRENT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Name your goal first, then pick the chapter with a bankruptcy attorney. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel in the courtroom, a clipboard reads GOAL FIRST THEN CHAPTER, comic burst banner reads DISMISSED, kids comic book illustration
